# Vintti

> Vintti is a LATAM remote staffing agency that connects US companies with nearshore talent from South America, delivering 70% cost savings on hiring.

Vintti specializes in providing remote staffing solutions across multiple industries including accounting, legal, healthcare, and administrative roles. The platform offers both industry-specific staffing services and detailed role guides to help companies hire and manage remote teams from Latin America.

## Key Topics

- LATAM talent acquisition
- nearshore staffing
- cost savings (70%)
- remote work
- South American talent
- accounting staffing
- financial management
- legal staffing
- healthcare staffing
- recruitment agencies
- US-LATAM hiring
- SMB staffing solutions
- startup talent solutions
- virtual assistant roles
- compliance management

## Core Services

- [Latam Remote Staffing Agency for US companies](https://www.vintti.com): Vintti homepage: LATAM remote staffing agency saving 70% on costs
- [Remote Staffing Agency for SMBs](https://www.vintti.com/services/for-smbs): Vintti remote staffing solutions for SMBs with South American talent
- [Startup Remote Talent Solutions](https://www.vintti.com/services/for-startups): Global talent acquisition for startups with cost-effective staffing
- [LATAM Talent for Firms](https://www.vintti.com/services/for-firms): Remote staffing for legal and financial services firms in LATAM
- [For Healthcare](https://www.vintti.com/services/for-healthcare): Healthcare SMB staffing with MedTech and HealthTech talent
